title: MORE MORE JUMP! Chapter1 Episode10 Cheering Up with Rin!

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Courtyard

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Shizuku hasn't read any of my messages. She's not answering my calls, either.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I guess I can't blame her after what I said.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'm not even worthy of being a friend, let alone an idol.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I got a message! Is it Shizuku?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: <Hi, Momoi. Are you busy today? If you have the time, I'd love it if you would help me practice!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Minori...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, that's right. I should help her practice some more.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Should I really be teaching her, though? I mean, I couldn't even make it as an idol.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Huh?
<Hello! I've come to see you♪>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Wh-What? Who was that?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Ta-da! Everyone's idol, Rin, is here☆>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Huh?! What is Rin doing on my phone?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <That's because I'm an idol, of course!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <It's only natural an idol would want to cheer up someone who is looking sad! That's why I've come to see you!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: W-Well yeah, I guess that's true, but...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<And I know that deep down, you really love idols.
Isn't that right, Airi?>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <So as an idol myself, I can't just sit back and do nothing!>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You're the one that said it, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Idols should never ignore those who dream of becoming idols themselves.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Everyone has times when they can't help feeling down.
But it's times like these I want them to listen to my songs♪>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Our music is sure to cheer you up and motivate you to look ahead and try even harder!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: To look ahead...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Heh. Thanks, Rin.
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
One, two, three, four!
Oh, I think I got it!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Minori!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, Momoi! You came!
I'm so glad!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I've finally perfected those steps I couldn't do before!
Would you let me know what you think?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You really are the tenacious type, aren't you?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Are you all right, Momoi? If you're not feeling well—

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Minori. I'm going to say something a little strange, okay?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Being an idol isn't all fun, you know.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Even if you debut and become popular, there are still a lot of things that never go the way you'd planned.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Between all the people involved, it gets harder and harder to do the things you want to do.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Knowing that, are you sure you still want to be an idol?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I do.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I want to become an idol!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I don't know what might have happened to you in the past.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: And I have no way of knowing what kind of hardships might lie ahead.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Still, this is the path I've chosen. No matter what happens, I won't regret choosing it!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: The path you've chosen...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You're right. It doesn't matter what others might say.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So long as I want to be an idol.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Momoi?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Heh. It looks like I'm the one who got cheered up.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You see, the agency I used to work for wanted to push me as a variety show entertainer.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I opposed their plan, but the agency I moved to after that told me the same thing.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: They said it'd be easier to remain in the industry longer that way than if I were to continue as an idol.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Even so, I wanted to be an idol. I wanted to be up on stage, giving hope to those in the crowd.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But in the end, nobody in the industry wanted me for that role anymore. It was too hard to bear.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Watching you made me realize something, though.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It's perfectly fine to become an idol purely because you want to!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'm not sure what I'm going to do about finding an agency or work, but...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I still want to become the kind of idol who gives hope to those around them.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So starting today, I'll be practicing with you, Minori. I'll start over from the beginning and we can chase our dream together. Okay?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Momoi...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Come on, fellow idol-in-training. Let's give it everything we've got. Just remember, I'm not gonna let you beat me!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Right! Let's get started!
Cheerful*Days Theater

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: Is everything all right, Shizuku? It's not like you to call me out of the blue like this.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: There's something important I wanted to discuss.
